harness.deterministic: the run is seeded from the mission; the policy is a pure function of state (except the seeded 'random' policy)

classification.deadlocked: no key changes the state at all
classification.only_escape_loses: every progress key is inert; Escape changes it and that is a lost run
classification.no_end_in_steps: state kept changing but the run never ended within maxSteps

costCap.note: COST (player.alarm) only rises from playing programs, and the turn only ends when the hand empties -- so the cap is where a fight can stop being playable
